# Marketing & Sales Software — Full Review Catalog

> All 61 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-09-11.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## AdCreative.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/adcreative-ai-review.html
- Verdict: AdCreative.ai: Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan. The meter counts downloads, not campaigns.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-15, read on their own homepage pricing table) Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan — only a 7-day trial with 10 credits. Three families, each with several credit steps.

## AgencyAnalytics
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agencyanalytics-review.html
- Verdict: AgencyAnalytics: The simplified Core plan is ~$20 per client/mo with no clients included in the base. Cost scales linearly with clients.
- Price: The simplified Core plan is ~$20 per client/mo with no clients included in the base — so cost scales directly with your roster (a 50-client agency pays ~$1,000/mo). Legacy plans start around $59–79/mo for 5 clients (2026).

## AgentNest
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agentnest-review.html
- Verdict: AgentNest — Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Thirteen days old and no reviews.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/agentnest) Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Free: unlimited catalogue scans, a catalogue readiness score, product-level issue reports and the full findings view.

## Aira
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aira-review.html
- Verdict: Aira is €149 per user a month, billed monthly, for the company database, AI prospecting, monitoring and on-demand research.
- Price: (read 2026-08-26 on aira.app/pricing) Aira is €149 per user a month, billed monthly, for the company database, AI prospecting, monitoring and on-demand research. Aira Connect starts at €499 a month, billed annually, and adds CRM enrichment and live signals on the accounts already in HubSpot, Salesforce or Pipedrive.

## AISDR
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisdr-review.html
- Verdict: AISDR: Solo is $250/mo or $2,400/yr for a sales team of one. Autonomous AI outreach is only as good as your targeting, list quality and messaging guardrails.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-09-09 on AiSDR's own pricing page) There are three published plans. Solo is $250/mo or $2,400/yr for a sales team of one: 200 AI-researched contacts a month, 1 user, 1 domain, 3 mailboxes, month-to-month.

## AISQ
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisq-review.html
- Verdict: AISQ: Squirrly SEO is billed monthly and renews at the same price. AISQ (the Squirrly family) evolves its pricing and product names often.
- Price: (2026-08-30, read on plugin.squirrly.co/wordpress-seo-pricing) Squirrly SEO is billed monthly and renews at the same price. Free $0.

## AltText.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alttext-ai-review.html
- Verdict: AltText.ai: Credit-metered — one credit = one image. The headline ‘5¢ per image’ only holds for a plain JPG in one language.
- Price: (re-verified 26 Aug 2026) Credit-metered — one credit = one image. Free trial: 25 credits, no credit card required.

## Amplemarket
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/amplemarket-review.html
- Verdict: Amplemarket: The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17) The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase; Growth and Elite are listed as Custom, so those numbers come from sales rather than the site. All plans include a free trial.

## Atlas AI Store Builder
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atlas-ai-store-builder-review.html
- Verdict: Atlas AI Store Builder: The listing says “Free to install”, but that is the development-store tier. The meter runs on your success, not your usage.
- Price: (prices read 2026-08-18 on apps.shopify.com/dropshipt and helloatlas.io) The listing says “Free to install”, but that is the development-store tier. A real store runs on the All-in-One plan at $39 a month, billed in USD with a 7-day free trial.

## Atria
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atria-review.html
- Verdict: Atria: Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. Its edge is competitor ad intelligence plus creative generation in one place.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 on their own pricing page, annual billing, which Atria advertises as 20% off) Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. That covers 5 seats, 4,000 AI credits a month, 50 brands followed without AI insights, 5 connected ad accounts, $500K of ad spend analysed a month, 5GB of asset storage and 3 brand profiles.

## Attribuly
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/attribuly-review.html
- Verdict: Attribuly: A free plan that covers the first $1,000 of recovered email revenue, then Capture at $450 a month and Recapture at $500.
- Price: (read 2026-08-18 on apps.shopify.com/attribuly) A free plan that covers the first $1,000 of recovered email revenue, then Capture at $450 a month and Recapture at $500. Rating 4.8 from 154 reviews.

## Aura
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aura-review.html
- Verdict: Aura: Starter $37/month ($451 a year), Essential $77 ($931), Plus $157 ($1,891), Pro $237 ($2,851). Pass $15K and Starter stops being the plan you are on.
- Price: (2026-08-28, checked line by line against their own pricing page; every figure below is the same as on 1 Aug 2026) Flat per account, not per seat, with unlimited listings on every tier. Starter $37/month ($451 a year), Essential $77 ($931), Plus $157 ($1,891), Pro $237 ($2,851) — annual saves 20%.

## AutoWrite
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/autowrite-review.html
- Verdict: AutoWrite — Free: 10 posts, 10 images, 1 workflow, basic SEO. The honest thing to say about this one is that there is nothing to judge yet.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19 in a browser on apps.shopify.com/autowrite, because the plan table renders client-side and a plain fetch returns nothing) Four tiers, metered on posts, images and workflows per month. Free: 10 posts, 10 images, 1 workflow, basic SEO.

## BidX
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/bidx-review.html
- Verdict: BidX: €295 for the default report, custom reports quote-only. The number that decides your bill is the one number the page does not print.
- Price: (2026-08-06, read in a live browser on their own pricing page, EUR view) Amazon PPC is sold in three tiers, and every one of them is a monthly fee plus an unspecified percentage of connected ad spend. They are Self Service Platform €495/month, Managed Platform €1,995/month and Managed Service €4,995/month.

## Campaign Monitor
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/campaign-monitor-review.html
- Verdict: Campaign Monitor: Contact-based, on three tiers. You pay for contacts, not sends — so a large, quiet list costs the same as a large, active one.
- Price: Contact-based, on three tiers — Lite (with a monthly send cap of about five times your contact count), Essentials (unlimited sends) and Premier (priority and phone support). We could not re-verify a plan amount on 2026-08-16.

## Capsule
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/capsule-review.html
- Verdict: Capsule: The free tier covers two users and 250 contacts. Capsule's simplicity is the product: it deliberately does less than the CRM giants.
- Price: (price page re-read 2026-09-11) The free tier covers two users and 250 contacts, and every paid card is quoted per user a month with a 14-day trial that needs no card. Read over a US connection on 26 August the annual figures were US$18 for Starter, US$36 for Growth and US$54 for Advanced, with contacts as the rungs: 250, 30,000, 60,000 and 120,000.

## Claap
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/claap-review.html
- Verdict: Claap — Pro is €24 per license a month billed yearly or €30 monthly: unlimited recordings, 1,000 minutes a month. The four tiers sell two different products.
- Price: (read 2026-09-04 on claap.io/pricing, both billing toggles and the full comparison table; re-verified 2026-09-08) Licenses are priced per license per month in euros. The only dollar figure on the page belongs to an add-on rather than a plan: a tooltip offers the Power Recorder, which adds unlimited recording length to any paid seat for $20 per seat a month.

## Close
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/close-review.html
- Verdict: Close: Solo $19, Essentials $49, Growth $109 and Scale $149 per user/mo, or $9, $35, $99 and $139 billed annually. The built-in calling is the draw.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-14, read on their own pricing page) Per-seat: Solo $19, Essentials $49, Growth $109 and Scale $149 per user/mo, or $9, $35, $99 and $139 billed annually. No free plan; the trial runs 14 days and close.com states no credit card is required, with $5 of calling and enrichment credits included, and the page carries a 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Code Bulk Discounts
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/code-bulk-discounts-review.html
- Verdict: Code Bulk Discounts: Two plans, billed in USD every 30 days. Read the free plan's number twice, because the word doing the work is 'lifetime'.
- Price: (prices read 2026-09-06 on apps.shopify.com/code-bulk) Two plans, billed in USD every 30 days. Free costs nothing and covers 500 lifetime codes with CSV export.

## Consentmo
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/consentmo-review.html
- Verdict: Consentmo: Billed in USD every 30 days, with a 7-day free trial on each paid tier. The accessibility side is a widget and a scanner.
- Price: (read 2026-09-08 on apps.shopify.com/gdpr-backpack and on the vendor's own consentmo.com/pricing, which list the same four tiers) Billed in USD every 30 days, with a 7-day free trial on each paid tier. Banner impressions are unlimited on every tier, the free one included, so the ladder gates features rather than traffic.

## Crazy Egg
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/crazy-egg-review.html
- Verdict: Crazy Egg: Three plans, all billed annually, with a 30-day free trial and — in the vendor's words — no overages, ever. The entry plan is thin on recordings.
- Price: (2026-08-21, read on their own pricing page) Three plans, all billed annually, with a 30-day free trial and — in the vendor's words — no overages, ever. Analytics starts at $29/month and scales on tracked pageviews across 5,000, 50,000, 150,000, 500,000 and 1,000,000 a month, starting at 50 recordings.

## Dripify
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/dripify-review.html

Month to month the same tiers read $59, $79 and $99 per user; both columns sit in the page and the FAQ repeats all six numbers in words.

## Fast Bundle

The listing is free to install and shows four tiers.

## Feedyio

- Price: (read 2026-09-10 on apps.shopify.com/product-feed-10 and feedyio.com/pricing) Nine published tiers, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify. The Shopify listing shows only the first four.

## GrapeLeads

- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-12, read on their own buy-credits page) Pay-as-you-go credit packs, bought once rather than subscribed to: Freelancer $28 for 50 credits ($0.56 each), Startup $55 for 100 credits ($0.54) and Agency $127 for 250 credits ($0.51). Bulk pricing is on request and signing up gives 20 free credits.

## Grapevine
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/grapevine-review.html
- Verdict: Grapevine: One plan, called Complete, at $25 a month, billed in USD every 30 days, with a 14-day free trial and no free tier.
- Price: (read 2026-09-10 on apps.shopify.com/grapevine) One plan, called Complete, at $25 a month, billed in USD every 30 days, with a 14-day free trial and no free tier. There is no response limit and no per-response charge: unlimited post-purchase, NPS, CSAT and attribution responses are included at that price, on every Shopify plan.

Starter is advertised at $7 per seat a month against a list price of $20 per seat a month, under a banner reading “Save up to 65% on Starter — new customers only, select offers available for a limited time”.

## Koongo
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/koongo-review.html
- Verdict: Koongo: Lite is $39 a month and updates every 6 hours, Starter is $79 and updates every 30 minutes. The headline price is a base, not a bill.
- Price: (read 2026-08-23 on apps.shopify.com/koongo, listed as “Koongo: Sell on Marketplaces”, and on koongo.com/pricing) Four tiers on the listing, separated by update frequency rather than by capability. Free covers one store language, 100 items or SKUs, 5 product feeds, one marketplace wizard and up to 10 orders a month, updating once a day.

## LangShop
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/langshop-review.html
- Verdict: LangShop: Basic is $10 a month or $100 a year. The named engines that the listing leads with — OpenAI, DeepL Pro, Google Cloud Translation.
- Price: (read 2026-09-10 on apps.shopify.com/langshop and langshop.app/pricing) Seven published tiers, billed in USD. The Shopify listing shows only the first four and links to 'more pricing plans'; the vendor's own pricing page prices the rest.

## Later
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/later-review.html
- Verdict: Later: Starter $18.75/month, Growth $37.50 and Scale $82.50, all billed yearly. The Starter caps are where the price really lives.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17) Starter $18.75/month, Growth $37.50 and Scale $82.50, all billed yearly, which Later advertises as three months free and 25% off against monthly. Every plan opens with a 14-day trial, and on the page as we read it on 31 August 2026 that trial is the only no-cost route offered: three paid tiers, nothing beneath them, and an FAQ that discusses users per plan rather than any zero-price option.

## Leadfeeder

## lemlist

- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17; the page served us DOLLARS today where our previous reading was in euros, with the same numerals — check your own checkout) No free plan, 14-day trial. Email is $69/month, or $55/month on yearly billing, covering unlimited users and 50,000 emails a month.

## Nextify.ai

- Price: (read 7 September 2026 on nextify.ai/pricing, signed in and signed out, in both billing modes) Five ways to pay, and the free plan is only visible when you are logged out — the signed-in pricing page starts at Starter. Free is $0 for 50 credits a month, watermarked, on the basic models only, and the page sells that as up to 2 videos and 25 images.

## NiceJob
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/nicejob-review.html
- Verdict: NiceJob: Reviews plan about $75/mo and Pro around $125/mo (adds referrals, AI replies, booking reminders). It automates review collection genuinely well.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-08-07) Reviews plan about $75/mo and Pro around $125/mo (adds referrals, AI replies, booking reminders), both with a 14-day trial and a one-off setup fee near $199 (2026). No contracts.

## noCRM
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/nocrm-review.html
- Verdict: noCRM: The page opens on annual billing, where Starter is €11, Expert €22 and Dream €33 per user a month. The pitch is that salespeople hate CRMs.
- Price: (read 9 September 2026 on www.nocrm.io/pricing, in both billing modes) Three per-seat tiers and no free plan. The page opens on annual billing, where Starter is €11, Expert €22 and Dream €33 per user a month; switch the toggle to monthly and the same tiers are €19, €29 and €39.

## Nutshell
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/nutshell-review.html
- Verdict: Nutshell — Two paid extensions sit alongside: Marketing from $49 a month and Engagement from $16 per user a month. Full API access is included on every plan.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17) Five CRM tiers on annual billing: Foundation $13, Growth $25, Pro $42, Business $59 and Enterprise $79 per user a month, with monthly billing about 15% higher (the page states the saving per tier as $6 to $10 a month per user). Unlimited contacts and full API access come with every tier, which is the unusual part — most CRMs ration one or both.

## PagePulse
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pagepulse-review.html
- Verdict: PagePulse — Free $0: 1 page, unlimited traffic, unlimited collaborators, 14 days of data retention and 15 AI insights a month.
- Price: (read 10 September 2026 on getpagepulse.io — the plans sit on the home page under the #pricing anchor; /pricing itself returns 404.) Five tiers, and the meter is pages plus AI insights rather than people. Free $0: 1 page, unlimited traffic, unlimited collaborators, 14 days of data retention and 15 AI insights a month.

## PartnerStack
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/partnerstack-review.html
- Verdict: PartnerStack publishes three plans — Launch, Growth and Enterprise. A record in the Partner API's customers endpoint is a tracked click, not a signup.
- Price: (read 2026-08-26 on partnerstack.com/pricing) There is no public price at any tier. PartnerStack publishes three plans — Launch, Growth and Enterprise — and every one of them carries a Book your demo button where the number would be; /plans is a 404.

## Pingtree
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pingtree-review.html
- Verdict: Pingtree: Self Service is “From $199” per month with a free trial included. We get paid whether or not you ever spend a cent with them.
- Price: (2026-08-27, read on their own pricing page) Self Service is “From $199” per month with a free trial included, and Managed Services carries a starting cost of $2,500, “scoped with your account team”. That is a rebuilt price list: the six named tiers that were on this page in July are gone, and there are now two paths rather than six.

## Pipedrive
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pipedrive-review.html
- Verdict: Pipedrive: Billed annually they are US$14, US$39, US$59 and US$79 per seat per month. Pipedrive manages what happens after a lead enters your pipeline.
- Price: (read 2026-08-26 on pipedrive.com/pricing over a US connection; the monthly column below is our 2026-08-16 reading from the EU) Four seat-based plans. Billed annually they are US$14, US$39, US$59 and US$79 per seat per month — which is one payment of $168, $468, $708 or $948 per seat per year, since Pipedrive charges the year up front.

## Quartile
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/quartile-review.html
- Verdict: Quartile: Budget for this one from a written quote, because nothing else exists. Everything about the sales motion here is a conversation.
- Price: (2026-08-07, read on their own site) There is no public pricing. quartile.com/pricing serves the same page as the homepage — no tier, no rate card and no entry figure anywhere on it, and the only call to action is Request Demo.

## Rank Math

Pro covers unlimited personal sites and 500 keywords; Business 100 client sites and 10,000 keywords; Agency 500 sites and 50,000.

## Reditus

## Scarcity.AI

The Low Stock Counter is $4.99 a month or $41.91 a year at a stated 30% saving, with a 7-day trial; its free tier is Development Stores, meaning development and partner stores only rather than a working free plan.

## Seller Investigators
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/seller-investigators-review.html
- Verdict: Seller Investigators: One number, and it is the whole model. Contingency pricing is the honest kind — you pay only out of money that arrived.
- Price: (2026-08-15, read on their own site) One number, and it is the whole model: a 25% commission, charged only after Amazon has deposited recovered funds in your account. We found it stated twice.

## Seller Snap
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/seller-snap-review.html
- Verdict: Seller Snap: Read them as $15,000 and $30,000 a month. Read the caps before you read the prices, because the caps are what you are actually buying.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-26 on their own pricing page, both the monthly and the annual column; every figure below was read again on that date and none of them had moved since 24 Jul 2026) There are four tiers, and the axis that sets your price is capacity, not features. All four list the same six feature groups: Amazon & Walmart, AI repricing technology, min & max calculation, analytics, connectivity and integrations.

## Similarweb

## Smarty Discounts
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/smarty-discounts-review.html
- Verdict: Smarty Discounts: Forever Free costs nothing, Lite is $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year. Add to that what the app needs to do its job.
- Price: (read 2026-09-04 on apps.shopify.com/smarty-discount) Three tiers, all billed in USD and recurring every 30 days. Forever Free costs nothing, Lite is $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year, and Pro is $25.99 a month or $259.99 a year; the annual price on both paid tiers saves 17%, and both carry a 7-day free trial.
